# Show the drawn GUI layers (gpiUpdateDisplay)

Commits all three GUI layers and their palettes to the display controller; the flip for double-buffered drawing.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60c9588b` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

d0 = 0 shows the buffer index held at 0x61ea1ecc, any other value the other buffer (index xor 2). Palette changes reach the controller only through this call.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Read in the code; called by the stock GUI after each redraw. Source: [E-M5 III 2D GUI drawing reference](../sources/em5n.osd-drawing.md).
- **Emulator** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): A 12-frame moving box on layer 2 ran with this call in om-emu. Source: [E-M5 III 2D GUI drawing reference](../sources/em5n.osd-drawing.md).
